promotion_gates.name: Data integrity
promotion_gates.rule: Every input row carries a source link; 2026 standings reconciliation vs the official capture has 0 mismatches.

promotion_gates.name: Sample size
promotion_gates.rule: >= 300 graded selections for signal claims AND >= 300 settled stakes for staking claims; below that the claim is 'insufficient n'.

promotion_gates.name: Walk-forward only
promotion_gates.rule: Every model line uses only games strictly before the game day (day-before-kickoff origination); verified by state_games_used column.

promotion_gates.name: Frozen holdout
promotion_gates.rule: Positive edge vs close on the frozen 2026 holdout (weeks 1-10).

promotion_gates.name: Uncertainty
promotion_gates.rule: 95% week-clustered bootstrap CI of the beat-close rate excludes 50%.

promotion_gates.name: Line value
promotion_gates.rule: Mean edge vs close > 0 with n >= 100 (only meaningful where entry != close).

promotion_gates.name: Luck removal (placebo)
promotion_gates.rule: Sign-flip permutation test p < 0.05 for beat-close rate > 50%.

promotion_gates.name: Stability
promotion_gates.rule: Edge vs close positive in >= 60% of seasons.

rules.trigger: Two consecutive evaluation windows with mean edge vs close <= 0
rules.action: LIVE -> PAPER at the next window boundary

rules.trigger: Results-feed integrity failure (feed stale > 7 days, or a verification status flips to UNVERIFIED on > 2% of new rows)
rules.action: LIVE -> PAPER for all strategies until the feed is re-verified

rules.trigger: Unpriced correlation exposure: realized leg-correlation of a parlay strategy exceeds its registered cap (measured with n from the official feed)
rules.action: LIVE -> PAPER for the parlay strategy until re-priced

config.cadence: evaluated after every week of settled results (weekly)
